name: 陳岡伯
objective: This course aims to enhance students’ speaking skills with a particular focus on listening comprehension, critical analysis of certain issues, organization of ideas, and lucid delivery of a speech. The course is designed thematically and divided into 6 teaching sections. Each section contains two weeks. In the first week, we will approach a specific issue by watching an introductory video clip, doing listening exercises and understanding key terms. And then students will be divided into groups to discuss and present their opinions regarding the issue. In the second week, we will further explore the issue by watching selected scenes from a relevant film. Each group will be asked to answer critical questions by analyzing the scenes, formulate and organize their ideas, and deliver a short speech at the end of the class.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Introduction

Unit 1: Education & Humanities
Week 2: Listening comprehension & discussion: creativity 
Week 3: Film analysis & discussion: The Dead Poets Society (1989)

Unit 2: Moral dilemma
Week 4: Listening comprehension and discussion: the trolley problem
Week 5: Film analysis and discussion: Scent of a Woman (1992)

Unit 3: Rethinking Evil
Week 6: Listening and comprehension: the banality of evil
Week 7: Film analysis and discussion: A Few Good Men (1992)

Unit 4: What counts as a hero?
Week 8: Listening and comprehension: tragic hero
Week 9: Film analysis and discussion: The Dark Knight (2008)

Week 10: Film viewing: Seven (1995)
Week 11: Mid-term group presentation

Unit 6: Humor and offense
Week 12: Listening comprehension and discussion: political correctness
Week 13: Film analysis and discussion: “Stunning and Brave” from South Park

Unit 6: Cross-cultural encounter
Week 14: Listening comprehension and discussion: cultural appropriation
Week 15: Film analysis and discussion: Pocahontas (1995)

Week 16: Film viewing: Get Out (2017)
Week 17-18: Final group presentation
